item.title: Exit Ticket
item.description: You will write an ’exit ticket’ reflecting on where you started and where you’ve gotten to, and you will indicate how you feel you’ve done against the learning outcomes. You will be required to explicitly tie your exit ticket to evidence collected in your weekly work - link to documentation you’ve uploaded to your github repoistory (or repositories). You will use the Exit Ticket to pull all the different strings together into a strong cord describing how your thinking has evolved and changed.
